=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:6249,6282 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: compose_synced_check_issue (6249) and compose_synced_check_occurrence (6282) write the consumer PR as a bare `#N`, which GitHub resolves against the upstream repository, so it links to and notifies an unrelated issue or PR.
  WHY: Severity disagreement: gemini said BLOCKER (critical), sonnet, minimax and glm said MAJOR, luna said NIT; the highest is used. Tests assert "#688" and "#699", which locks in the bad form, and line 6282 does not name the repo at all.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:422 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `WORKFLOW_HEAL_ENABLED:-true` opt-out check in triage_upstream_send never fires because .github/workflows/check_failure_triage.yml does not export WORKFLOW_HEAL_ENABLED to the job or the route step (about lines 235-264 and 661-674).
  WHY: A consumer that sets WORKFLOW_HEAL_ENABLED=false still sends a repository_dispatch with its repo, PR number, check name and paths upstream.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:413-470,830-868 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The dedup gate only matches an open consumer issue carrying the fingerprint marker, and a routed failure creates no consumer issue, so every new failing run on the same PR re-runs diagnosis and sends another repository_dispatch.
  WHY: Neither side has a per-PR, per-check or per-head idempotency key, so dispatch volume and occurrence comments grow with pushes.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:1711-1739 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The fallback diagnosis embeds untrusted CI log text, and triage_upstream_classify (line 1739) parses it for AFFECTED_FILES markers as authoritative.
  WHY: A PR-controlled check log can steer routing to an upstream dispatch; the managed-digest check limits the impact to unmodified managed paths. Severity disagreement: luna said MAJOR, minimax said NIT, and sonnet gave it only as a hardening suggestion. The highest is used.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:6146,6352 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `check_run_id` and `--check-run-id` are accepted by build_synced_check_payload and _cmd_build_synced_check_payload but never read.
  WHY: A caller that passes the flag gets no effect and no error. The only current caller omits it.
- .github/workflows/check_failure_triage.yml:~665 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The "Route upstream-managed check failure" step runs, and exports GH_PAT, even in the upstream repository.
  WHY: The script's self_repo guard prevents any send, so this is not exploitable. Adding `github.repository != 'shubhodeep1/coding-workflows'` to the `if:` would remove the exposure.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_synced_security.py:test_synced_check_intake_skips_its_own_repository (~729) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The assertion accepts either the self-repo skip or any report_auth=rejected result.
  WHY: A regression in the self-repo skip would still pass. This came from the reviewers' hardening suggestions.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Reuse `build_sync_manifest.py managed-digests`. Reuse or factor out the audit's resolver; do not add a second managed-file list."
  expected_change_site: scripts/security_audit.sh (WRAPPER_PIN_PATTERNS, normalize_wrapper_pins, upstream_managed_status) and scripts/build_sync_manifest.py, or a shared resolver
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: scripts/build_sync_manifest.py adds its own normalize_wrapper_pins, classify_managed_path and classify_paths, scripts/security_audit.sh keeps its inline copy unchanged, and the parity test (tests/test_build_sync_manifest.py) only checks that the two agree. The managed-digest map itself is reused. Severity NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  PROBLEM: WORKFLOW_HEAL_ENABLED is never exported by check_failure_triage.yml, so the opt-out never fires. security-audit.yml exports it at lines 499 and 519.
  WHY: A consumer that opted out still sends a repository_dispatch carrying its repo name, PR number, check name and paths upstream.

  PROBLEM: The consumer PR number is written as a bare `#N` in the upstream issue and occurrence comment.
  WHY: It autolinks to an unrelated upstream issue or PR; line 6282 names no repo. Tests assert "#688" and "#699".
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:6146,6352 | severity=NIT | confidence=4

  WHY: The flag has no effect and no error. No production caller is affected.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:830-868, 413-470 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The dedup gate matches only open consumer issues, and a routed failure creates none.
  WHY: Every new failing run repeats diagnosis and sends another dispatch, adding an occurrence comment and an intake job each time.
- .github/workflows/check_failure_triage.yml:~665 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The route step runs, and exports GH_PAT, in the upstream repository.
  WHY: Not exploitable, because the script exits with self_repo. The PAT is still exposed to the step.

  Expected change site: scripts/security_audit.sh or a shared function
  Evidence of absence: build_sync_manifest.py has new copies of the pin normalisation and classification, security_audit.sh is untouched, and a parity test checks only that they agree. The managed-digest map is reused. | severity=NIT | confidence=4
- HARDENING: scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:1739 | PROBLEM: The fallback DIAG_FILE holds PR-controlled log text that the AFFECTED_FILES parser trusts. | FIX: Track a used_fallback_diagnosis flag and write {"decision":"file","reason":"fallback_diagnosis"} (about 6 lines).
- HARDENING: tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_synced_security.py:test_synced_check_intake_skips_its_own_repository | PROBLEM: The assertion is too loose. | FIX: Assert "skip reason=synced_check_self_repo" alone (2 lines).
- HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
